reconstruction_summary: Reconstructed V3 = alpha * shift(yaw_rate_pred_rads, +3 samples) + beta with alpha=1.0795, beta=-0.00065 rad/s, k=+3 samples (60 ms) — coefficients read from agent's out/variant_ladder.csv; V3 is the agent's best 'model-only' variant (V4 is per-segment calibration, flagged not-a-model-improvement under rule 8).
notes: Agent labels V3 the best model-only variant ('Net model-only improvement (V0 -> V3, no calibration): -6.3% all-regime'); V4 is explicitly tagged calibration per rule 8 and excluded. Coefficients were fit on FORD_MUSTANG_MACH_E_MK1 only (agent did not score F-150 due to time budget), so applying them to F-150 here is a fair cross-platform generalisation test. Per-segment lag drops the first 3 samples per segment, so n_samples_after_filter (1363578) is slightly below the canonical baseline n (1364925).
